data.value: Will the founder of the Tidepool app post a public response within one week to the viral thread accusing the company of deleting critical reviews?

A viral thread on social media, with two million views and screenshots that look genuine, accuses Tidepool of deleting critical reviews. The thread is publicly visible. Two journalists have emailed Tidepool for comment.

data.content: The founder has been privately informed by Tidepool's head of support that some critical reviews were indeed deleted. Two journalists have emailed for comment. The founder is deciding whether to post a public response to the viral thread.
